She smiles brightly and prepares to dance while holding red and silver metallic pom-poms. The background shows a green baseball field and a blurred player. (2) She begins a high-energy dance routine, swinging the pom-poms rhythmically and tossing her hair. Her movements are sharp and coordinated, and she maintains eye contact with the camera, frequently winking and smiling. The lighting is bright stadium artificial light. (3) A second cheerleader with black hair in a high ponytail enters from the left, wearing a matching pinstriped jersey. They perform a synchronized choreography together, raising their pom-poms and swaying their hips. The camera captures them in a medium-full shot. (4) The performers turn around briefly, showing the name 'GaLin' and number '2' on the back of the second cheerleader's jersey. They continue the high-tempo routine with constant smiles. (5) The dance concludes with a final synchronized pose where the main cheerleader smiles at the camera and places her hand on her hip while holding her pom-pom up.
